decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - (3)	NON-STD	The noise levels from the proposed roof-top plant (specified as four air handling units) should be inaudible when assessed from the nearest noise sensitive receiver.

Condition : 5 - (4)	NON-STD	The level of noise emitted from the proposed roof-top plant (specified as four air handling units), shall not be less than 10dB(A) below the existing background noise levels (LAeq) when measured over any 24 hour period from the nearest noise sensitive receiver.
Condition : 6 - (5)	The structures shall be removed when no longer required for use.
description: Installation of airconditioning plant to the roof of existing building.
